claims.text: DeBERTa-based assessor models can match or exceed subject language models' confidence in refinement.
DeBERTa-based assessor models can match or exceed subject language models' confidence in calibration.
Performance prediction assessors anticipate subject language model failures at near perfect levels for some tasks.
Learning from performance scores on multiple tasks can be beneficial for language model performance prediction.
Learning from performance scores across multiple subject models can be beneficial for language model performance prediction.
Large and small subject language model systems are equally predictable by performance assessors.

evidence.description: Assessors can match and even exceed the subjects’ confidence in refinement.
Assessors can match and even exceed the subjects’ confidence in calibration.
Assessors anticipate failures at near perfect levels for some tasks.
For performance prediction it can be beneficial to learn from the scores on multiple tasks.
For performance prediction it can be beneficial to learn from the scores of multiple subjects.
Large and small subject systems are equally predictable, showing promise for scalability.

methodologies.name: DeBERTa performance prediction assessors
methodologies.description: Fine-tuning DeBERTa models on evaluation results of generative language models to predict whether questions will be answered successfully.
conditions: Generative language model subject systems up to 128 billion parameters

limitations.text: The performance prediction benefits derived from learning across multiple tasks or multiple subject systems depend on the specific task at hand.
